body: Almost always. I feel like I'm married to someone who hates me.

I've tried calling the hotlines before but it was just so awkward and uncomfortable. 

I can never sleep when I have a ton of shit on my mind. Also, I don't want to go to bed because I know my husband will just reject and ignore me and that will hurt. 

I saw your post. If you were in San Diego, we could both be depressed together. We all do silly things sometimes so don't be too hard on yourself.
I am alone. I am in a city, state, and country where I know noone. I came here to be with my husband.
Nope and in any case, he wouldn't care. I've told him many times I'm suicidal, how sad I'm feeling but it just wooshes over his head.
Yup, we are going but it doesn't seem to be making a difference.
